title: Rule 03 — Modal-verb sandwich
short: kann, muss, möchte, and darf are useful verbs that send the main verb to the end.
body: Treat the second verb as a bookend. This pattern makes an enormous number of sentences possible.
examples: I would like to make an appointment.
pitfall: Incorrect: Ich möchte kaufen eine Fahrkarte. Correct: Ich möchte eine Fahrkarte kaufen.
